newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan industrial taxes up 13.4 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China Jan industrial taxes up 13.4 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China collected 56.785 billion yuan ($6.84 billion) in industrial and commercial taxes in January, up 13.4 percent from a year-ago period, the China Taxation News said on Monday.

Taxes collected by the central government totalled 26.626 billion yuan in January, up 10.9 percent from the same month in 1996, while taxes collected by local governments were 30.159 billion yuan, up 15.8 percent, the newspaper said.
Of the total taxes, the amount of value-added taxes and consumption taxes hit 26.497 billion yuan, up 14 percent year-on-year, it said.
Despite the rise in tax revenue, tax arrears by enterprises also rose sharply, it said. Total tax arrears increased by 7.8 billion yuan in January.
China's collection of personal taxes reached 1.929 billion yuan in January, up 48.4 percent from a year-ago period, it said.
